title: HSK1 Gate 1 · Xia Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 1: Xia Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第1关：夏朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 很久以前，中国的水很大。水很大，很多人没有家。大禹是一位好人。王请他去看水，让他想办法。
passageEn: Long ago, the waters of China were very high. The water was very big; many people had no home. Dayu was a good person. The king asked him to look at the water and find a way.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Long ago, the waters of China were very high.
comprehension.answer: 很久以前，中国的水很大。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 久 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“久”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 久 (jiǔ) means "long time" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “久”（jiǔ）的意思是“long time”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 以前 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“以前”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 以前 (yǐ qián) means "before" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “以前”（yǐ qián）的意思是“before”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 很久以前，中国的水很大。

options.text: The bones were big, and many characters could be written on them.
Long ago, the waters of China were very high.
Long ago, China had a dynasty called the Shang.
Shang Dynasty people wrote characters on bones.

check.explanationEn: "很久以前，中国的水很大。" means "Long ago, the waters of China were very high.".
check.explanation: “很久以前，中国的水很大。”的意思是“Long ago, the waters of China were very high.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Xia Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说夏朝。
